Hammotzi et ishto mishshum shem ra o mishshum shehi perutza bindarim omrin lo hodiah shemmippene ze atta motziah kede leyasserah veda sheen atta machazirah leolam. umippene ma hammotzi et zo lo yachazirah leolam. gezera shemma tinnase leacher vetaase teshuva vetihye tzenua tachtav veyomar harishon illu hayiti yodea shekken hu lo hayiti megarshah venimtza kimgaresh al tenay velo nitkayyem shennimtza hagget batel lemafrea. lefichach omrim lo gemor belibbecha legarshah sheen zo chozeret lecha leolam. veim avar vehechezir kodem shennitkaddesha leacher lo yotzi:

Vechen hammotzi et ishto mishshum aylonit o mishshum sheroa dam bechol et tashmish hare ze lo yachazir leolam. shemma tinnase leacher veteled haaylonit vetitrappe hannidda veyomar illu hayiti yodea shekken hu lo hayiti megarshah venimtza hagget batel vehabbanim mamzerim. veim avar vehechezir lo yotzi:

Shaliach shehevi get chutza laaretz veamar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam hare ze lo yissaenna. sheanu choshshin shemma enav natan bah ulefichach heid lah. vechen haed haechad sheheid leishsha shemmet balah venisset al piv hare ze lo yissaenna. vechen hechacham sheasar et haishsha al balah beneder hare ze lo yissaenna. vechen hannitan al hashshifcha venishtachrera al hannachrit venitgayyera hare ze lo yissaenna. vechen akku"40 veeved habba al bat yisrael af al pi shechazar haakku"40 venitgayyer haeved venishtachrer hare ze lo yissaenna. vechullan im avru venasu en motziin miyyadam:

Vechullan shehayu lahem nashim umetu neshotehen o shennitgarshu vehayu hannashim hen shehirgilu et baalehen legarsham hare ellu muttarot lehinnase lahen lechattechilla. vechen im halchu nashim ellu venisseu laacherim venitalmenu o nitgarshu hare ellu muttarot lehinnase lahen lechattechilla:

Vechol achat mehen mutteret lehinnase leven haed sheheid lah. o leven hechacham sheasarah al balah. o leven hannitan aleha o lishar kerovin. sheen adam chote kede sheyyehane acher. umutteret haishsha lehinnase leechad meede gerusheha o meede meuneha. o leechad min haddayyanim shechaltza bifnehem. sheen choshshin ella leedut echad. uleolam yitrachek adam meedut meun veyitkarev lachalitza:

Hamegaresh et ishto vechazar uvealah bifne edim kodem shettinnase leacher ben sheggershah min hannissuin ben min haerusin hoil veishto hayta hare zo bechezkat shehechezirah uleshem kiddushin baal velo leshem zenut. vaafillu rau oto shennatan lah maot. shechazaka hi sheen adam ose beilato beishto beilat zenut vahare beyado laasotah beilat mitzva. lefichach hare zo bechezkat mekuddeshet kiddushe vadday utzericha mimmennu get sheni:

Nityached immah bifne edim vehu sheyyihyu shene haedim keechad. im hayta megoreshet min hannissuin choshshin lah shemma nivala vehen hen ede yichud hen hen ede bia. shekkol hamekaddesh bevia eno tzarich livol bifne edim ella yityached bifnehen veyivol kemo shebbearnu. lefichach tzericha get missafek vahare hi safek mekuddeshet. veim hayta megoreshet min haerusin en choshshin lah shehare en libbo gas bah:

Horu miktzat haggeonim shekkol ishsha shettibbael bifne edim tzericha get. chazaka sheen adam ose beilato beilat zenut. vehigdilu vehosifu bedavar ze sheala al datam ad shehoru shemmi sheyyesh lo ben mishshifchato choshshin lo velo tityabbem ishto shemma shichrer shifchato veachar kach ba aleha. veyesh mi shehora shevvadday shichrerah sheen adam ose beilato beilat zenut. vechol haddevarim haelle rechokim hem beenay ad meod middarche hahoraa veen rauy lismoch alehen. shello amru chachamim chazaka zo ella beishto sheggershah bilvad o bimkaddesh al tenay uvaal setam shehare ishto hi uveishto hi shechezkato sheeno ose beilat zenut ad sheyyefaresh shehi beilat zenut o yefaresh sheal tenay hu boel. aval bishar hannashim hare kol zona bechezkat shebbaal leshem zenut ad sheyyefaresh ki hu leshem kiddushin. veen tzarich lomar beshifcha o kutit sheenah bat kiddushin sheen choshshin lahen kelal. vahare habben mehen bechezkat kuti veeved ad sheyyivvada bevadday shennishtachrera immo o nitgayyera:

Mi shehuchzeka eshet ish ben min hannissuin ben min haerusin veyatza shemah bair megoreshet. afillu rov hair o kullah maavirin hakkol shennitgarsha en choshshin lah vahare hi bechezkatah. aval im yatza shemah bair mekuddeshet vehuchzak hakkol bevet din shehare hi mekuddeshet besafek kemo shebbearnu veachar kach yatza aleha kol shennitgarsha meotan hakkiddushin hakkol asarah vehakkol hittirah vahare zo megoreshet:

Lo yissa adam ishsha vedato legarshah. velo tihye yoshevet tachtav umeshammashto vedato legarshah. velo yegaresh adam ishto rishona ella im ken matza bah ervat davar shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 1)</small> "ki matza vah ervat davar" vegomer. veen rauy lo lemaher leshalleach ishto rishona. aval sheniyya im seneah yeshallechenna:

Ishsha raa bedeoteha vesheenah tzenua kivnot yisrael hakkesherot mitzva legarshah shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 22 10)</small> "garesh letz veyetze madon". veishsha shennitgarsha mishshum peritzut en rauy leadam kasher sheyyissaenna. shello yomru ze hotzi reshaa mibbeto veze machnisah:

Mi shennitcharsha ishto hare ze megarshah beget vetihye megoreshet. aval im nishtattet eno motziah ad shettavri. vedavar ze takkanat chachamim hu kede shello tehe hefker lifrutzin shehare enah yechola lishmor atzmah. lefichach mannichah venose acheret umaachilah umashkah mishshellah. veen mechayyevin oto bisher kesut veona sheen koach beven daat ladur im hashshotim bevayit echad. veeno chayyav lerappeotah velo lifdotah. veim gershah hare zo megoreshet umotziah mibbeto veeno chayyav lachazor ulehittafel bah:
Mishneh Torah, Divorce 11: En nosin et hakketonna. vehannose ketanna yetoma velo ratzta babbaal hare zo memaenet veholechet veenah tzericha mimmennu get. sheen kiddushin shel ketanna kiddushin gemurin kemo shebbearnu. vechen ketanna shehissiah aviha venitalmena o nitgarsha keshehi ketanna hare hi kitoma bechayye aviha. veim nisset keshehi ketanna hare zo memaenet:
Hachereshet af al pi shennissueha middivre sofrim kenissue ketanna lo tikkenu lah shettemaen kede shello yimmanu millenasah:

Memaenet hi hakketanna ben min haerusin ben min hannissuin. ben bifne balah ben shello befanav. ucheshem shemmemaenet bevaal kach memaenet beyavam. umemaenet bevaal ze umemaenet besheni im nisset leacher vechen bishlishi afillu kamma peamim kol zeman shehi ketanna yesh lah lemaen. uketanna shello meana af al pi shehi nesua vehalcha venitkaddesha leacher keshehi ketanna kiddusheha hem hem meuneha:

Ad matay habbat memaenet. kol zeman shehi ketanna ad shettihye naara o ad sheyyivvada shehi aylonit. bamme devarim amurim beshello ba aleha habbaal achar shennaaset bat 10"2 shana veyom echad. aval im higgia lazzeman hazze venivala hoil vehabbeila kona min hattora kemo shebbearnu hare zo enah memaenet. veenah tzericha bedika lemeun shechezkatah shehevia simanin:

Hare shennivdeka velo nimtzeu lah simanim hoil venivala achar shehiggia lazzeman harauy lesimanin hare zo choshshin lah shemma hevia venashru. ulefichach tzericha get missafek. veim meana achar shennivdeka venitkaddesha leacher tzericha mimmennu get missafek. veim nisset tetze mizze umizze vehavvalad sefek mamzer mishshenehem:

Ketanna shello meana vehigdila veaf al pi shello bealah balah mishshennaaset bat shetem esre shana veyom echad hare zo enah memaenet shehare higdila. utzericha get middivre sofrim shehare lo ba aleha achar shehiggia lishne naarut ad shennachush lah shemma hevia simanin vetihye safek mekuddeshet, velo ba aleha achar shehigdila kede shettihye eshet ish gemura. venimtzet sheenah tzericha get ella minnissue katnut shehen middivre sofrim. lefichach im amda venitkaddesha achar sheggadla tofsin bah kiddushin shel sheni. veim geresh harishon yichnos hashsheni. aval im geresh sheni lo yekayyem rishon shemma yomru hechezir gerushato meachar shennitarsa. veim ba aleha sheni kodem sheyyegaresh rishon tetze mizze umizze mippene sheddome leishsha sheshshama shemmet balah venisset veachar kach ba balah. veen havvalad min hashsheni mamzer. veim ba aleha rishon kodem sheggeresh sheni havvalad mamzer:

E zo hi ketanna shetztzericha lemaen. mibbat shesh ad bat eser shanim bodkin otah lefi yefi datah im yodaat lishmor kiddusheha veshehen kiddushin lo shettishmor otan kederech shemmeshammeret haegoz utemara vechayyotze bahen hare zo tzericha meun. veim enah yodaat lishmor kiddusheha enah tzericha lemaen ella holechet levet immah keillu lo nitkaddesha meolam. ufechuta mibbat shesh afillu yodaat lishmor enah tzericha meun. vitera al bat eser afillu sechala beyoter tzericha meun. vechol mi shehissiuha acheha o immah o keroveha shello ledatah enah tzericha lemaen:

Ketzad memaenet. omeret bifne shene edim en retzoni bifloni bali. o en retzoni bakkiddushin shekkiddeshuni immi o achay. vechayyotze bidvarim ellu. afillu hayu orchin mesubbin bevet balah vehi omedet umashka alehen veamra eni rotza bifloni bali hare ze meun:

Hashshenayim shemmemaenet hakketanna bifnehen kotvin lah beyom peloni meana pelonit bat peloni befanenu bifloni balah vechotmin venotnin lah. veze hu gufo shel get meun. veget meun eno keget haggerushin shennetinato megarshah. veeno tzarich ketiva lishmah velo mesira velo davar mimmishpete get haggerushin. veen kotvin bo tafse hagget shemma yerae keget gerushin lefi sheeno ella kemaase bet din:

Hashshenayim shemmemaenet bifnehen tzerichin sheyyehu makkirin otah veet balah shemmeana bo. lefichach kol mi sheraa otah shemmeana veshama meuneha yesh lo lichtov get meun lah af al pi sheen makkirah. uchevar nahagu yisrael lichtov get meun benosach ze:

Get meun:
bechach beshabbat kach vechach yom lechodesh peloni shenat kach vechach leminyan peloni meana pelonit bat peloni befanenu veamra sheimmi o achay hituni vehissiuni o kiddeshuni vaani ketanna lifloni bar peloni vehasheta gilliti dati kodomechon dela tzavina beh velo kaemna immeh. uvedakna pelonit da veitbarer lana daadayin ketanna hi uchetavna vachatamna veyahivna lah lizchut veliraya berura: peloni bar peloni ed: peloni bar peloni ed:

Hamegaresh et ishto venitkaddesha leacher af al pi shello bealah neesra al harishon. veim hechezir harishon uvealah loke vechofin oto lehotzi shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 4)</small> "lo yuchal balah harishon" vegomer:

Zinneta im acher keshehi gerusha mutteret lachazor levalah shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 2)</small> "veyatza mibbeto vehalcha vehayta leish acher". havayatah leish acher shehi hakkiddushin hi sheoseret otah al balah lachazor lo:

Uvichlal lav ze shekkol ishsha shezzinneta tachat balah neesra alav veloke aleha shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 4)</small> "achare asher huttammaa" vahare nitmea. ella im ken hayta eshet yisrael shenneensa. lefichach kol ishsha shenneesra al balah al yede kinnuy usetira im baal otah makkin oto makkat mardut. veim avar vehechezirah achar sheggershah yotzi beget:

Cheresh sheggeresh birmiza kemo shebbearnu vehalcha venitkaddesha lecheresh acher veen tzarich lomar lefikkeach asura lachazor levalah hacheresh. aval ishto shel pikkeach shennitgarsha vehalcha venisset lecheresh venitgarsha mutteret lachazor levalah happikkeach:

Hamemaenet beish enah megoreshet mimmennu. vedinah im balah shemmeana bo kedinah im mi shello kiddeshah meolam. hi mutteret bikrovav vehu muttar bikrovoteha velo pesalah min hakkehunna. veim nisset leacher vegershah haacher o met o meana bo mutteret lachazor larishon. velo od ella afillu gershah harishon vehechezirah umeana bo venisset leacher achar shemmeana bo vegershah haacher mutteret lachazor larishon. shekkol hayyotzet bemeun af al pi shekkedamo get hare zo kemi shello nitgarsha mimmennu beget meolam umutteret lachazor lo. aval hamegaresh et hakketanna beget venisset leacher umeana bo asura lachazor larishon mippene sheyyatzat mimmennu beget af al pi sheyyatzat min haacharon bemeun. veen tzarich lomar im gershah haacharon o met. vechen asura laavi harishon velivno uleachiv kishar haggerushot af al pi sheyyatzat min haacharon bemeun:
Hamemaenet beyavam asura leaviv mippene shenniret kechallato beet shemmet beno. aval lishar kerovim mutteret. lefichach im meana beechad min hayyavamin mutteret leechav:

Kol ishsha shennitgarsha o shennitalmena hare zo lo tinnase velo titares ad shettamtin tishim yom chutz miyyom shennitgarsha o shemmet balah bo vechutz miyyom shennitarsa bo. kede sheyyivvada im hi meubberet o enah meubberet lehavechin ben zaro shel rishon lezaro shel sheni:
Umiyyom ketivat hagget monin limgoreshet. vaafillu haya al tenay o shello higgia leyadah ella leachar kamma shanim miyyom hakketiva monin. shehare eno mityached immah mishshekketavo lah:

Ugezerat chachamim hi sheafillu ishsha sheenah reuya leled vaafillu nitgarsha o nitalmena min haerusin tzericha lehametin tishim yom. afillu ketanna o zekena o akara o aylonit. vaafillu balah bimdinat hayyam o chole o chavush bevet haassurin vaafillu betula min haerusin tzerichot lehametin tishim yom:

Shifcha shennishtachrera vegiyyoret shennitgayyera mamtinin tishim yom. vaafillu ger veishto shennitgayyeru mafrishin otan tishim yom kede lehavechin ben zera shennizra bikdushsha lezera shello nizra bikdushsha. vechen yefat toar af al pi shennatna lah tora sheloshim yom letakkanat atzmah tzericha lehametin tishim yom letakkanat havvalad. vehashsheloshim mikkelal hattishim:
Hamemaenet enah tzericha lehametin. lo gazru ella bigrusha. vechen hamezanna enah tzericha lehametin mippene shemmeshammeret atzmah shello titabber. vechen anusa umefutta enan tzerichot lehametin:

Mi shennisset betaut venoda shehi asura levalah vehotziuha bet din mittachtav. im hayta ketanna sheenah reuya leled enah tzericha lehametin. shezze davar sheeno matzuy hu vechol davar sheeno matzuy berov lo gazru bo:
Hameares betoch tishim yom menaddin oto. eres uvarach en menaddin oto. kanas betoch tishim yom mafrishin otan ad achar zeman veyaamod im ishto:

Vechen gazru chachamim shello yissa adam meubberet chavero umeneket chavero. veaf al pi shehazzera yadua lemi hi meubberet. shemma yazzik havvalad bishat tashmish sheeno makpid al ben chavero. umenika shemma yitakker hechalav vehu eno makpid lerappeot hechalav bidvarim hammoilin lechalav kesheyyitakker:
Kamma hu zeman hayenika. 20"4 chodesh chutz miyyom shennolad bo umiyyom shennitarsa bo:
Keshem sheasur lissa kach asur leares ad achar zeman ze. afillu natna benah lemenika o sheggemalattu betoch 20"4 chodesh lo tinnase. met benah mutteret linnase. veen choshshin shemma tahargennu:

Avar venasa meubberet o menika betoch zeman ze yotzi beget vaafillu haya kohen. veim haya yisrael yachazirenah achar 20"4 chodesh shel menika. nasa uvarach uleachar zeman ba veyashav im ishto en bechach kelum. eres meubberet o menika en kofin oto lehotzi velo lichnos ad achar zeman hayenika o ad sheyyamut havvalad:
Mishneh Torah, Divorce 12: Haishsha shebbaa veamra eshet ish hayiti ugerusha ani neemenet. shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir. huchzeka eshet ish uvaa veamra gershani bali enah neemenet lehattir atzmah lashshuk. aval pasla atzmah lichhunna leolam. veim met balah choshshin lidvareha vecholetzet velo mityabbemet:

Hayu lah shene edim shehi gerusha af al pi sheen sham get hare zo tinnase lechattechilla. hotzia get mittachat yadah veamra gershani bali baze hare zo neemenet vetinnase bo af al pi sheeno mekuyyam kemo shebbearnu:

Ba habbaal veirer im amar lo netattiv lah ella nafal mimmenni umatza oto eno neeman. shehare hoda shekketavo lah vahare hu yotze mittachat yadah. aval im amar habbaal al tenay haya. pikkadon haya. meolam lo ketavtiv. mezuyyaf hu. yitkayyem bechotmav o beede mesira kemo shebbearnu. veim lo nitkayyem enah megoreshet lihyot mutteret laacherim aval pasla nafshah mikkehunna kemo shebbearnu. shehare pasla atzmah behodaat piha veasta atzmah kachaticha shel issur:
Baa hi uvalah. hi omeret gerashtani veavad gitti. vehu omer lo gerashtich. af al pi shehuchzeka ishto hare zo neemenet. chazaka en ishsha meizza paneha bifne balah:

Amar habbaal gerashti et ishti eno neeman vechoshshim lidvarav vetihye safek megoreshet. vaafillu hodet lo sheggershah eno neeman shemma yitkavven lekalkelah o beget batel gershah vehi enah yodaat [o shemma taez paneha bo mippene shehu maaminah vehi enah yodaat] koved haissur shellah. lefichach omrim lo im emet haddavar hare attem kayyamim garesh otah atta befanenu:

Shenayim omrim nitgarsha ushenayim omrim lo nitgarsha afillu habbaal omed vehi omeret lo gerashtani hare zo bechezkat eshet ish gemura mippene shehaedim somchin otah veefshar shettaez paneha. lefichach im nisset tetze vehavvalad mamzer:

Bamme devarim amurim kesheamru achshav nitgarsha shehare omrin lah im emet haddavar hotzii gittech. aval im amru haedim mikkamma yamim nitgarsha yesh lomar avad hagget vehoil vehi omeret gerusha ani bevadday ushene edim meidin lah af al pi shehashshenayim machchishin otan im nisset leechad meedeha lo tetze shehare hi uvalah yodin bevadday shehi mutteret vachazaka hi sheen mekalkelin atzman. aval im nisset leacher hoil vehaddavar etzlo safek. vechen im amra eni yodaat afillu nisset leechad meedeha hare zo tetze vehavvalad sefek mamzer:

Amru shenayim reinuha shennitgarsha ushenayim omrim lo reinuha. im hayu kullam sheruyim bechatzer achat hare zo lo tinnase. veim nisset lo tetze vehavvalad kasher. shebbene adam asuyin legaresh betzina:

Haishsha shello huchzeka eshet ish uva ed echad veamar eshet ish hayta venitgarsha. uva ed echad veamar lo nitgarsha. hare shenehen meidin shehi eshet ish veechad meid shehi gerusha veen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim ulefichach lo tinnase veim nisset tetze:

Ishsha ushene anashim shebbau mimmedina acheret. ze omer zo ishti veze avdi. veze omer zo ishti veze avdi. vehaishsha omeret shenehen avaday. hare hi mutteret lakkol veaf al pi sheshshenehen hechezikuha beeshet ish hoil vechol echad mehen heid leatzmo enan neemanin:

Sheliach kabbala shehotzi get mittachat yado vehabbaal omer mezuyyaf hu yitkayyem bechotmav o beede mesira kemo shebbearnu. amar habbaal lefikkadon netattiv lo vehashshaliach omer legerushin netano li hashshaliach neeman. vechen im haya hagget yotze mittachat yede haishsha vehi omeret shaliach ze netano li, vehashshaliach omer ken netattiv lah ulegerushin netano li, vehabbaal omer lo netattiv lo ella lefikkadon, hashshaliach neeman vehi megoreshet:

Avad hagget af al pi shehabbaal omer legerushin netattiv lashshaliach vehashshaliach omer netattiv lah hare zo sefek megoreshet shehare huchzeka eshet ish veen kan ella ed echad uvaal. vaafillu amra haishsha befanay netano lo legerushin unetano hashshaliach li hoil vehabbaal vehashshaliach soadin otah efshar shettaez paneha veshemma lo nitgarsha:

Sheliach kabbala shekkibbel get leishsha ushelacho lah bifne shene edim vehiggia hagget leyadah unetalattu vahare hagget yotze mittachat yadah. vehi enah yodaat im balah shelacho lah o sheliach kabbala shellah o shelucho shel balah. hare zo megoreshet kemo shebbearnu:

Ba baal veirer shello ketavo o shehu get batel yitkayyem bechotmav shehare edim meidim shehagget shennatnu lah yatza mittachat yad sheluchah sheyyado keyadah. veaf al pi shehi enah yodaat hare haedim yadu. veim lo nitkayyem enah megoreshet:

Mi shehuchzeka eshet ish vehalcha hi uvalah limdinat hayyam veshalom beno levenah veshalom baolam uvaa veamra met bali neemenet vetinnase o tityabbem. chazaka sheenah mekalkelet atzmah veteesor atzmah al balah harishon veal ze vetafsid ketubbatah mizze umizze velihyot baneha mamzerin bedavar heasuy lehiggalot lakkol. vei efshar lehachechish velo liton taana sheim hu chay sofo lavo o yivvada shehu chay. vechen im ba ed echad veheid lah shemmet balah tinnase al piv shehaddavar asuy lehiggalot. afillu eved o ishsha o shifcha veed mippi ed mippi eved mippi shifcha mippi kerovav neemanim lomar met peloni vetinnase ishto o tityabbem al pihem:

Vehakkol neemanim lehaid lah edut zo chutz mechamesh nashim shechezkatam sonot zo et zo sheen meidot zo lazo bemitat balah shemma yitkavvenu leasrah alav vaadayin hu kayyam. veellu hen. chamotah. uvat chamotah. vetzaratah. vivimtah. uvat balah. afillu akku"40 hammesiach lefi tummo neeman umassiin al piv kemo sheyyitbaer. veim nitkavven lehaid eno neeman:
Vechen happasul baavera min hattora im ba lehaid beishsha shemmet balah eno neeman. veim haya mesiach lefi tummo neeman en ze pachut min haakku"40. aval pasul middivrehem neeman leedut ishsha:

Ba ed echad veheid shemmet balah vehittiruha lehinnase al piv veachar kach ba acher vehichchish et harishon veamar lo met hare zo lo tetze mehetterah vetinnase. sheed echad neeman beedut ishsha kishne edim bishar eduyyot veen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim:

Bau shenehem keechad ze omer met veze omer lo met. ishsha omeret met veishsha omeret lo met. hare zo lo tinnase. veim nisset tetze mippene shehi safek. veim nisset laed sheheid lah vehi omeret bari li shemmet hare zo lo tetze. bau shenayim veamru lo met af al pi shennisset tetze:

Bamme devarim amurim beshehaya haed echad shennisset al piv kemo hashshenayim shebbau vehichchishu oto. kegon shennisset al pi ish uvau shenayim veamru lo met. o shennisset al pi ishsha o al pi atzmah uvau shete nashim o shene pesulin shel divrehen veamru lo met. aval ed kasher omer met venashim rabbot omrot lo met o pesulin omrim lo met hare ze kemechetza al mechetza. veim nisset leechad meedeha vehi omeret vadday met hare zo lo tetze:
Ishsha omeret met o hi sheamra met bali veachar kach ba ed kasher veamar lo met hare zo lo tinnase. veim nisset tetze:

Ishsha omeret lo met ushete nashim omrot met hare zo tinnase. vechen im amru eser nashim lo met veachat esre omrot met hare zo tinnase. sheen omrim shenayim kemea ella beedim kesherim aval bifsulin hallech achar harov ben lehakel ben lehachamir:
Shene edim omrim met ushenayim omrim lo met hare zo lo tinnase. veim nisset tetze mippene shehi safek. veim nisset leechad meedeha vehi omeret bari li shemmet hare zo lo tetze:

Mi sheyyesh lo shete nashim uvaa achat mehen veamra met bali hare zo tinnase al pi atzmah kemo shebbearnu. vetzaratah asura sheen tzara meida lachavertah. vaafillu nisset zo techilla en omrin illu lo met balah lo hayta oseret atzmah alav. shemma missinatah betzaratah rotza hi sheyyeasru shetehen alav. zot omeret met bali vetzaratah machcheshet otah veomeret lo met hare zo tinnase. keshem sheenah meida lah lehattirah kach enah yechola lehaid lah leasrah. zot omeret met vetzaratah omeret neherag hoil ushetehen omrot sheeno kayyam hare ellu yinnasu:
Mishneh Torah, Divorce 13: Haishsha sheamra levalah gerashtani bifne peloni ufeloni uvau otan haedim vehichchishuha veachar kach halcha hi uvalah veshalom baolam uvaa veamra met bali enah neemenet. shezzo huchzeka shakranit verotza lehishshamet mittachat balah. ba ed echad veheid lah shemmet balah lo tinnase shemma hi sachra oto. veim nisset lo tetze shehare yesh lah ed:

Vechen im hayta milchama baolam uvaa veamra met bali bammilchama enah neemenet veaf al pi shehaya shalom beno levenah (shemma) tismoch datah al devarim sherubban lemita vetomar met kegon shennehergu harishonim vehaacharonim shehaya balah beemtzaan shehare hi omeret meachar shennehergu ellu veellu neherag hu bichlalan. lefichach enah neemenet vaafillu amra met bammilchama ukevartiv. aval im amra met al mittato neemenet:
Lo huchzeka milchama baolam uvaa veamra milchama hayta bemakom peloni umet bammilchama lo tinnase lechattechilla. veim nisset lo tetze:

Vechen haishsha sheamra met bali tachat hammappolet enah neemenet. vechen im haya shilluach nechashim veakrabbim veamra neshacho nachash o akrav vamet enah neemenet. shemma tismoch datah al rov anashim shemmetu kach binshicha:
Amra ishshenu alenu bayit o meara hu met vaani nitztzalti enah neemenet. keshem shennaasa lah nes kach naasa lo. hayta shenat reavon veamra met bali enah neemenet. met ukevartiv neemenet:
Amra naflu alenu akku"40 o listim hu neherag vaani nitztzalti neemenet. sheen darkan laharog et hannashim kede shennomar keshem shennitztzela hi kach nitztzal hu:

Haya dever baolam veamra met bali neemenet sheddavar pashut befi kol adam shebbishnat haddever ze chay veze met. veefshar sheyyamutu baddever nearim chazakim veyinnatzlu hazzekenim hacholim. ulefi ze en choshshin lah shemma samcha datah al rov hammetim:

Kevar amarnu sheed mippi ed kasher leedut ishsha. bamme devarim amurim sheshshama mippi ben daat shemmet peloni kegon eved o shifcha. aval im shama mippi shote o mippi katan eno meid veen somchin al divrehem:

Shama min hattinokot shehen omrin achshav banu mehesped peloni kach vechach safdanin hayu sham ufeloni hechacham ufeloni ala achar mittato kach vechach asu bemittato hare ze meid mippihen al pi haddevarim haellu vechayyotze bahen umassiin et ishto:
Yisrael sheamar haragti et peloni hare zo tinnase al piv sheen adam mesim atzmo rasha vahare heid shemmet:

Kevar amarnu shehaakku"40 shehesiach lefi tummo massiin al piv. ketzad. haya akku"40 mesiach veamar oy lifloni shemmet kamma haya nae vechamma tova asa immi. o shehaya mesiach veomer keshehayiti ba badderech nafal peloni shehaya mehallech immanu vamet utemehani ledavar ze ketzad met pitom vechayyotze bidvarim haellu shehen marin sheen kavvanato lehaid hare ze neeman:

Yisrael sheshshama meakku"40 hammesiach lefi tummo meid sheshshama mimmennu vetinnase al piv. bamme devarim amurim shello hayta sham amatla. aval im hayta sham amatla besichat haakku"40 shemma lo yitkavvin ella ledavar acher. kemo sheamar leechad ase li kach vechach shello eherog otcha kederech sheharagti peloni. en ze mesiach lefi tummo shekkavvanato lehattil ema al ze:
Vechen im shama meerkaot shel akku"40 sheamru haragnu peloni enam neemanin. shehen machazikin yede atzman bechazav kede lehattil ema. vechen kol kayyotze bidvarim ellu:
Akku"40 shehesiach lefi tummo techilla af al pi sheshshaalu oto achar kach uvedakuhu ad sheyyefaresh kol hameora hare ze neeman umassiin al piv:

Kevar hodanu shehaed sheamar shamati shemmet peloni afillu shama meishsha sheshshama meeved hare ze kasher leedut ishsha umassiin al piv. aval im amar haed o haishsha o haeved met peloni vaani reitiv shemmet. shoalin oto heach raita uvema yadata shemmet. im heid bedavar barur neeman veim heid bidvarim sherubban lemita en massiin et ishto sheen meidin al haadam shemmet ella kesherauhu shemmet vadday veen bo safek:

Ketzad. rauhu shennafal layyam afillu tava bayyam haggadol en meidin alav shemmet shemma yatza bemakom acher. veim nafal lemayim mekubbatzim kegon bor o meara sheomed veroe kol sevivav veshaha kede shettetze nafsho velo ala meidin alav shemmet umassiin et ishto. vechen im hishlichuhu bayyam vehishlichu metzuda acharav veheelu mimmennu evar shei efshar sheyyinnatel min hachay veyichye hare ze meidin alav shemmet umassiin et ishto:

Rauhu shennafal legov arayot unemerim vechayyotze bahen en meidin alav. efshar shello yochluhu. nafal lachafirat nechashim veakrabbim o letoch kivshan haesh o letoch yora rotachat melea yayin o shemen o sheshshachatu bo shene simanin o rubban afillu amad uvarach meidin alav shemmet. shevvadday sofo lamut. vechen kol kayyotze baze middevarim shei efshar sheyyichye ella yamut miyyad bizman karov hare ellu meidin alav:

Rauhu tzaluv vehaof ochel bo af al pi sheddekaruhu o yaru bo chitztzim eno meid alav shemmet. veim rau haof ochel bemakom shehannefesh yotza bintilato kegon mocho o libbo o bene meav hare ze meid alav shemmet:

Ed echad omer reitiv shemmet bammilchama o bemappolet o shettava bayyam haggadol vamet vechayyotze bidvarim ellu sherubban lemita im amar kevartiv neeman vetinnase al piv. veim lo amar kevartiv lo tinnase. veim nisset lo tetze:

Vechen haishsha sheheid lah ed echad shettava balah bayyam o bemayim sheen lahem sof velo ala veavad zichro venishtakkach shemo hare zo lo tinnase al edut zo kemo shebbearnu. veim nisset lo tetze. vaafillu haya haakku"40 shehesiach lefi tummo veamar tava peloni bayyam venisset al piv hare zo lo tetze. vechacham shehora lehassiah lechattechilla menaddin oto:

Metzauhu harug o met. im paddachto vechatmo ufartzuf panav kayyamin vehikkiruhu bahen shehu peloni meidin alav. veim nittal echad meellu af al pi sheyyesh lahem simanin begufo uvechelav vaafillu shuma en meidin alav shemma acher hu. bamme devarim amurim besherauhu betoch shelosha yamim achar harigato o achar mitato. aval achar shelosha en meidin alav mippene sheppartzuf panav mishtanne:

Tava bayyam vehishlicho hayyam layyabbasha afillu achar kamma yamim. im hikkiru panav vechatmo meidin alav, sheeno mishtanne bammayim ella leachar zeman merubbe. veim shaha bayyabbasha achar shehushlach min hayyam 10"2 shaot venitpach en meidin alav shehare nishtanna. keshemmistakkelin betzurato kede lehakkiro lehaid alav bodkin oto veroin oto afillu ballayla leor hanner o leor hallevana:
Rau echad omed merachok veomer shehu peloni ben peloni o peloni mimmakom peloni vahare neshacho nachash vahare hu met vehalchu umetzauhu shennishtanna velo hikkiruhu hare ellu massiin et ishto:

Ba echad veamar amru li bet din o anashim keshettelech lemakom peloni emor lahem shemmet yitzchak ben michael. uva hashshaliach veamar lanu. vehashshaliach eno yodea mi hu ze. hoil veanu yodim peloni hayyadua beshem ze hare ishto mutteret veen omrin shemma yitzchak ben michael acher hu shemmet:

Yatza akku"40 veyisrael meimmanu lemakom acher. uva haakku"40 vehesiach lefi tummo veamar ish sheyyatza immi mikkan met. massiin et ishto veaf al pi sheen haakku"40 yodea oto haish. vehu sheyyomar kevartiv:

Vechen im yatzu asara bene adam keechad mimmakom lemakom vehen asurin bekolar o nosim gemallim vechayyotze bidvarim ellu. vehesiach haakku"40 lefi tummo veamar sheasara anashim shehalchu mimmakom peloni lemakom peloni vehem nosim kach vechach metu kullam ukevarnum massiin et neshotehen:

Yisrael sheamar met ish yehudi immanu bemakom peloni kach vechach tzurato vechach hayu simanav. en omrim beomed haddaat peloni hu ad sheyyaid haed shehu peloni veyazkir shemo veshem iro. aval im amar echad yatza immanu meir pelonit umet. mechappesin beotah hair im lo yatza mishsham ella hu tinnase ishto:

Matzu katuv bishtar met ish peloni ben peloni o neherag peloni ben peloni venoda shezze katav yisrael hare ze tinnase ishto. vechen mi shennishtattek uvadku oto kederech shebbodkin legittin venimtzet dato mechuvvenet vechatav shemmet peloni ben peloni somchin al ketivato vetinnase. veen bodkin ede ishsha bidrisha vachakira shello amru chachamim baddavar lehachamir ella lehakel mishshum hattarat aguna:

Al yikshe beenecha shehittiru chachamim haerva hachamura beedut ishsha o eved o shifcha o akku"40 hammesiach lefi tummo veed mippi ed umippi hakketav uvelo derisha vachakira kemo shebbearnu. shello hikpida tora al haadat shene edim ushear mishpete haedut ella bedavar sheen atta yachol laamod al buryo ella mippi haedim uveedutan kegon sheheidu shezze harag et ze o hilva et ze. aval davar sheefshar laamod al buryo shello mippi haed hazze veen haed yachol lehishshamet im en haddavar emet. kegon ze sheheid shemmet peloni. lo hikpida tora alav. sheddavar rachok hu sheyyaid bo haed besheker. lefichach hekellu chachamim bedavar ze veheeminu bo ed echad mippi shifcha umin hakketav uvelo derisha vachakira kede shello tishshaarna benot yisrael agunot: <small>seliku lehu hilchot gerushin besiyyata dishmayya</small>
Mishneh Torah, Levirate Marriage and Rel: Mitzvat ase min hattora sheyyeyabbem adam eshet achiv meaviv ben min hannissuin ben min haerusin im met belo zera shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 5)</small> "uven en lo" <small>(Devarim 25 5)</small> "yevamah yavo aleha". umin hattora en tzarich lekaddesh yevimto shezzo ishto hi shehiknu otah lo min hashshamayim ella yavo aleha. uchetubbatah al nichse balah shemmet:

Lo ratza leyabbem o shello ratzta hi. hare ze choletz lah veachar kach tihye mutteret lehinnase leacher. umitzvat ase min hattora lachalotz im lo ratza leyabbem shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 9)</small> "vechaltza naalo" vegomer. umitzvat yibbum kodemet lemitzvat chalitza:

Ze shenneemar battora <small>(Devarim 25 5)</small> "uven en lo" echad habben veechad habbat o zera habben o zera habbat hoil veyesh lo zera mikkol makom. uven meishsha zo ben meacheret hare ze poter et ishto min hachalitza umin hayyibbum. afillu haya lo zera mamzer o oved avoda zara hare ze poter et ishto min hachalitza umin hayyibbum:

Aval beno min hashshifcha umin hakkutit eno poter et ishto shezzera habba min hashshifcha avadim vehabba min kutit kuti ucheillu enam. hare hu omer beshifcha <small>(Shemot 21 4)</small> "haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha" melammed shevveladah kemotah. uvechutit hu omer <small>(Devarim 7 4)</small> "ki yasir et bincha meacharay" mesir oto millechashev bakkahal. veaf al pi shennishtachrer beno min hashshifcha o nitgayyer beno min hakkutit hare hen kishar haggerim vehameshuchrarin veenam potrin et ishto. hare shehaya lo ben min hashshifcha shello veshichrero veshichrerah unesaah umet belo zera hare zo tityabbem leachiv veaf al pi shebbenah mimmennu kayyam shekkevar shichrero:

Mi shemmet vehinniach ishto meubberet. im hippila achar moto hare zo tityabbem. veim yalda veyatza havvalad chay laavir haolam afillu met beshaa shennolad hare immo petura min hachalitza umin hayyibbum. aval middivre sofrim ad sheyyivvada bevadday shekkalu lo chodashav venolad letisha chodashim gemurim. aval im lo noda lechamma nolad. im chay sheloshim yom hare ze velad kayyama ufoter neshe aviv min hachalitza umin hayyibbum. veim met betoch hashsheloshim afillu beyom hashsheloshim ben shemmet mecholi ben shennafal min haggag o achalo ari hare ze safek nefel safek ben kayyama utzericha chalitza middivre sofrim. aval lo tityabbem:

Mi sheyyesh lo ach mikkol makom afillu mamzer o oved avoda zara ben katan ben gadol mishsheyyatza rosho verubbo laavir haolam kodem sheyyamut achiv hare ze zokek et ishto leyibbum. veim haya lo ach min hashshifcha o min hakkutit eno achiv ledavar min haddevarim veeno zokek et ishto. veaf al pi shehayta ledato bikdushsha hoil vehayta horato shello bikdushsha eno achiv:
Achim min haem enan chashuvin achim (ella laavelut uleedut aval) leinyan yerushsha o leinyan yibbum vachalitza hare hen kemi sheenan. sheen achva ella meav:

Gerim shennitgayyeru vaavadim shennishtachreru en lahen achva kelal vahare hen kezarim ze laze. vaafillu echad mehem horato shello bikdushsha veledato bikdushsha vehashsheni horato veledato bikdushsha hare hen kezarim. vaafillu teomim venoldu bikdushsha en benehen achva ad shettehe horatan veledatan bikdushsha:

Mi shehayu lo nashim rabbot vamet. biatah o chalitzatah shel achat mehen poteret et hashshear veeno meyabbem lishtayim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 9)</small> "asher lo yivne et bet achiv" bayit echad hu bone veeno bone shene battim. vechen im hayu lo achim rabbim echad mehen choletz o meyabbem leachat min hayevamot veyutteru shear hatztzarot:
Hayu bivamot ellu kesherot lichhunna ufesulot. im haya meyabbem meyabbem lee zo sheyyirtze. veim haya choletz yachalotz lappesula kede shello yifsol et hakkeshera lichhunna bachalitza:
Metu lo achin rabbim venaflu neshotehen lefanav. im efshar lo leyabbem et kullan meyabbem veim lav choletz. o choletz lemi sheyyirtze mehen umeyabbem lemi sheyyirtze achat mikkol bayit uvayit:

Hakkones et yevimto neesru tzaroteha alav veal shear haachin veim ba hu o echad mehaachin al tzaratah hare ze over baase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 5)</small> "yevamah yavo aleha" velo aleha veal tzaratah velav habba mikkelal ase ase. vechen hacholetz livimto neesra hachalutza hi vechol tzaroteha al hacholetz veal shear achin. vechullan asurot alehen middivre sofrim kishniyyot. shemmeachar shemmet achiv belo valad nistallek issur erva meal kol nashav lefichach tofsin bahen hakkiddushin kishniyyot:

Hacholetz livimto keshem shehi asura alav kach kerovoteha asurot alav. kegon immah uvittah. vechen hi asura livno uleechav. vaafillu sheniyyot shellah asurot kegon bat bat bittah. vechen hi asura leven ben beno. kelalo shel davar hare hi keishto sheggershah. vechen im meta yevimto vaadayin hi zekuka lo asur bikrovoteha keillu hayta ishto umeta tachtav. vechol haissurin haellu middivrehen. umuttar adam lissa achot tzarat chalutzato ushear kerovoteha:

Asur leyavam lissa kerovat zekukato kegon immah o bittah ad sheyyeyabbem echad meechav lah o yachalotz lah vetasur zikkato mealeha veyissa immah o bittah o shear kerovoteha. af al pi shehen kullan asurot al achiv shechalatz o yibbem kemo shebbearnu:
Hakkones et yevimto vegershah im ratza lehachazir yachazir mippene shehi ishto lechol davar velo nishar aleha shem issur mippene achiv kelal lo middivre tora velo middivre sofrim:

Kevar bearnu behilchot ishut shebben tesha shanim veyom echad biato bia vedavar ze halacha mippi hakkabbala. lefichach yavam katan shebba al yevimto im haya ben tesha shanim veyom echad yekayyem. aval eno choletz ad sheyyigdal veyibbadek shehare <small>(Devarim 25 7)</small> "ish" katuv bapparasha leinyan chalitza. veim haya pachot mizze en biato bia. uviat ben tesha shanim enah kona kinyan gamur. lefichach en yevimto nitteret lezar ad sheyyavo aleha achar sheyyigdal o ad shettachalotz kemo sheyyitbaer:

Vechen hayevama hakketanna im ratza hayyavam leyabbem otah meyabbem aval enah choletzet ad shettagdil vetibbadek. vaafillu nivala achar 10"2 shana enah choletzet ad shettivdok veyimtzeu bah hassimanin:
Keshem sheen hayyavam choletz ad sheyyease ish kach en hayevama choletzet ad shettease ishsha gedola. veyavam katan shebba al yevama ketanna yigdelu ze im ze:

Hayevama lo tityabbem velo tachalotz ad shettamtin tishim yom chutz miyyom hammita umiyyom hayyibbum umiyyom hachalitza kishar kol hannashim. umippene ma lo tachalotz betoch tishim yom mippene sheenah reuya leyibbum veneemar <small>(Devarim 25 7)</small> "im lo yachpotz haish lakachat et yevimto" <small>(Devarim 25 9)</small> "vechaltza naalo" vegomer beet shehi ola leyibbum ola lachalitza vechol zeman sheenah ola leyibbum enah ola lachalitza. veim yibbem otah o chalatz betoch hashshelosha chodashim hoil veenah meubberet hare zo niftera veenah tzericha kelum:

Hacholetz livimto venimtzet meubberet veyalda. im haya valad shel kayyama hare zo kemi shello nechletza lo meolam umutteret lichhunna umuttar bikrovoteha. veim hippila o shello shaha sheloshim yom achar shennolad chozer vecholetz lah hu o echad meechav. shechalitzat hameubberet enah chalitza uviat hameubberet enah yibbum:
Lefichach hakkones o hacholetz livimto hameubberet lo tinnase tzaratah ad shetteled zo. sheen havvalad mattir ad sheyyetze laavir haolam:

Hakkones et yevimto venimtzet meubberet mafrishin otan umamtinin lah. im hippila yachazor vikayyem. veim yalda afillu met bayyom shennolad hare ze motziah beget vecholetz lah veachar kach tihye mutteret laacherim. veim nitkayyem havvalad sheloshim yom achar shennolad hare ze valad shel kayyama veenah tzericha mimmennu get mippene shehi erva alav:

Yalda leachar shishsha chodashim mishshennityabbema valad shel kayyama hare ze havvalad safek im ben tisha larishon im ben shiva laacharon lefichach yotzi beget vehavvalad kasher. veim ba aleha achar sheyyalda habbanim sheyyavou acharav safek mamzerim:

Middivre sofrim shello yavo hayyavam al yevimto ad sheyyekaddesh otah bifne shene edim bifruta o bishve peruta vezehu hannikra maamar. veen hammaamar kone bayvama kinyan gamur kemo habbia. vehaose maamar bivimto shello middatah lo asa kelum sheen haishsha mitkaddeshet ella lirtzonah. uketanna min haerusin en osin bah maamar ella middaat aviha:

Ucheshem shehu mekaddesh et yevimto kach hu mevarech birkat nissuin baasara vechotev ketubba kedin kol nose ishsha. habba al yevimto velo asa bah maamar kana kinyan gamur veeno tzarich lachazor ulekaddesh achar habbeila. umakkin oto makkat mardut. vechotev lah ketubba:

Habba al yevimto ben beshogeg ben bemezid ben beones ben beratzon. ben shehaya hu mezid vehi shogeget o anusa. ben shehayta hi mezida vehu shogeg o anus. ben shehayta yeshena ben shehayta era (ben shebba aleha kedarkah ben shello kedarkah). echad hameare veechad haggomer kana:

Bamme devarim amurim shennitkavven livol aval (im nafal min haggag venitka bah o) shebba aleha shikkor sheeno makkir kelum o yashen lo kana. nitkavven ledavar acher vehetiach bivimto lo kana. lehatiach bivhema vehetiach bivimto kana shehare nitkavvin leshum beila mikkol makom:

Yevama shennityabbema veamra betoch sheloshim yom lo nivalti veaf al pi shehu omer baalti vegershah kofin oto sheyyachalotz hoil vekiddem vegershah beget. veim adayin lo geresh kofin oto sheyyivol o yachalotz veyotzi beget. gershah leachar sheloshim yom vehi omeret lo nivalti mevakkeshim mimmennu sheyyachalotz lah. veim haya mode shello baal kofin oto lachalotz. hi omeret nivalti vehu omer lo baalti enah tzericha chalitza sheen ze neeman leasrah al kol adam achar shekkenasah:

Mi shemmet vehinniach achim rabbim mitzva al haggadol leyabbem o lachalotz shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 6)</small> "vehaya habbechor asher teled". mippi hashshemua lamdu sheeno medabber ella bivchor shebbaachin kelomar gedol haachin yakum al shem achiv hammet. veze shenneemar asher teled mashmao asher yalda haem veen mashmao asher teled hayevama:
Lo ratza haggadol leyabbem mechazzerin al kol haachin. lo ratzu chozrin etzel haggadol veomrin alecha mitzva o chalotz o yabbem. veen kofin et hayyavam leyabbem aval kofin oto lachalotz:

Amar haggadol hametinu li ad sheyyagdil hakkatan o ad sheyyavo haholech o ad sheyyavri hacheresh venimmalech bo veim lo yirtze ani ayabbem o ani echlotz en shomin lo. ella omrin lo alecha mitzva o yabbem o chalotz:
Vechen im haya haggadol bimdina acheret en achiv hakkatan yachol lomar al achi haggadol hi hammitzva hametinu lo ad sheyyavo ella omrin leze shehu kan yabbem o chalotz:

Yevama haruya leyibbum shello ratzta lehityabbem dinah kedin moredet al balah vechofin et yevamah lachalotz lah vetetze belo ketubba. veim hinniach achiv nashim rabbot kol mi shettevaah hayyavam mehen leyibbum velo ratzta hi hammoredet vecholetz lah vetetze belo ketubba. ushear tzaroteha shello nitbeu notlot ketubbatan kishar haalmanot:
Hayu hayevamin rabbim vetava otah haggadol leyibbum vehi enah rotza bo verotza beachiv en shomin lah, shemmitzva baggadol leyabbem:

Amar haggadol eni rotze lo leyabbem velo lachalotz. hare achay lefanayich. vetava otah echad min haachin leyibbum vehi enah rotza bo veratzta beach acher vehu rotze bah. en zo moredet meachar shennistallek haggadol shemmitzva bo hare kullan shavin vehoil vehi rotza beechad mehen vehu rotze bah hare zot lo marda. velo od ella im haya echad mehen bimdina acheret veamra hare ani mamtenet oto ad sheyyavo viyabbem oti aval ze eni rotza bo en zo moredet. veomrim leze sheeno haggadol hattovea otah im tirtze lachalotz lah velitten lah ketubba chalotz. veim lav hare ratzta shetteshev ad sheyyavo achicha hoil veen lecha din kedima alav:

Ba ze shettalta bo velo ratza bah. chozrin etzel ze shettava otah leyabbem vehi enah rotza bo. veomrin lah en kan mi sheratza leyabbem ella ze umitzvat yibbum kodemet. o tityabbem lo o tetze belo ketubba kedin kol moredet:

Kol yevama sheamarnu sheddinah shettachalotz velo tityabbem hare zo notelet ketubbatah im yesh lah ketubba kishar kol haalmanot. vechen im haya yevamah mukke shechin o sheyyesh bo shear mume anashim choletz lah venotelet ketubbatah. noldu bah mumin keshehi shomeret yavam, nistachafa sadehu. im lo ratza leyabbem yachalotz veyitten ketubba:

Yevama shennadra hanaya mivamah bechayye balah. o shennadra hanaya mikkol hayyehudim. kofin oto sheyyachalotz lah vetittol ketubbatah. veim nadra leachar mitat balah mevakkeshim mimmennu sheyyachalotz lah veim lo ratza hare zo moredet. vechen im nitkavvena benidrah afillu bechayye balah kede shello yeyabbem otah en kofin oto lachalotz ella im ken marda vetetze belo ketubba:

Yevama shettevaah hayyavam lachalitza vehi omeret eni choletzet velo notelet ketubba ella eshev bevet bali vechishar kol haalmanot en shomin lah. shehare hiknu otah leze min hashshamayim. ratza meyabbem ratza choletz venoten ketubba. velo od ella afillu amra ani nizzonet mishshelli veeshev aguna kol yeme chayyay en shomin lah. shehare hayyavam omer lah kol zeman sheat zekuka li en notnin li ishsha acheret. vaafillu haya nasuy efshar sheyyissa ishsha acheret o tihye lo meriva betoch beto mippene hayevama:

Yevama shello haya lah al balah ketubba mippene shehayta asura alav vahare hi mutteret layyavam kemo sheyyitbaer. im ratza hayyavam leyabbem meyabbem veen lah alav ketubba kederech shello haya lah al balah. vedinah im yevamah battosefet kemo shehayta im balah. aval im lo katav lah balah ketubba o shemmachra lo ketubbatah o machala otah tzarich hayyavam lichtov lah ketubba kishar haalmanot:

Hayevama kodem sheyyavo aleha yevamah o kodem sheyyachalotz lah hare hi asura lehinnase lezar shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 5)</small> "lo tihye eshet hammet hachutza leish zar". veim nisset leacher uvaal loke hu vehi umotziah beget. vaafillu hayu lo kamma banim mimmenna. veneesra alav veal yevamah. vivamah choletz lah veachar kach tihye mutteret laacherim:

Nitkaddesha leacher lo neesra al yevamah ella noten lah hazzar shekkiddeshah get vivamah meyabbem o choletz. veim haya yevamah kohen sheeno yachol lissa gerusha tetze min hazzar beget kede shello yehe hachote niskar. veyachalotz lah yevamah:

Chazar hazzar sheggershah min haerusin unesaah achar shechalatz lah yevamah en motziin otah miyyado. aval im gershah min hannissuin vechazar unesaah achar shechaltza motziin otah miyyado mippene shehi doma leeshet ish shennisset uva balah shehi asura al ze veal ze kemo shebbearnu. vehayevama shezzinneta vehi zekuka lo neesra al yevamah ella ratza choletz ratza meyabbem:

Kol yevama shehi safek middivrehem im yesh aleha zikkat yavam o en aleha zikkat yavam. kegon yevama sheyyalda valad shello kalu lo chodashav umet betoch sheloshim yom sheddinah shettachalotz missafek middivrehem kemo shebbearnu. im halcha venitkaddesha leacher kodem chalitza choletz lah yevamah veteshev im balah. veim nitkaddesha lechohen shehu asur bachalutza eno choletz lah. sheen osrin al ze ishto mishshum sefek divrehen. gershah hakkohen o met hare zo choletzet veachar kach mutteret laacherim lechattechilla:
Haomer ze beni o sheamar yesh li banim hare ze neeman ufoter et ishto min hachalitza umin hayyibbum:
Amar ze achi o sheamar yesh li achin eno neeman leesor et ishto ulehannichah zekuka leyavam shehare ze mitkavven leasrah leachar moto:

Haya muchzak sheyyesh lo achin veamar bishat mitato en li achin eno neeman. vechen im amar al mi shehuchzak achiv en ze achi eno neeman. lo haya muchzak beachin veyatza kol sheyyesh [sham] edim sheyyaidu sheyyesh levalah achin vehaedim bimdina acheret. afillu amar hu bishat mitato en li ach hare zo chosheshet vetamtin ad sheyyavou haedim sheamru veyishalu:

Mi shezzana im ishsha ben penuya ben eshet ish venitabbera veamar ze haubbar mimmenni hu vaafillu hi moda lo af al pi shehu beno leinyan yerushsha hare ze safek leinyan yibbum. keshem shezzinneta im ze kach zinneta im acher. umeayin yivvada haddavar shezze beno vadday vahare en lo chazaka. ella leolam safek hu ulehachamir danin bo vecholetzet velo mityabbemet:

Neeman ed echad lehaid livama shemmet balah umityabbemet al piv. o shemmet yevamah o shennittan levalah ben, lehattirah lezar. afillu eved o ishsha o akku"40 mesiach lefi tummo meid bemitat hayyavam kemo shemmeid beeshet ish lehattirah kemo shebbearnu behilchot gerushin:
Vechamesh nashim sheen meidot zo lazo shemmet balah kach en meidin lah shemmet yevamah. vedin edut zo kedin otah edut leinyan edim shemmachchishin ze et ze bemitat hayyavam ulechol davar:

Shete yevamot shebbau mimmedinat hayyam zo omeret met bali vezo omeret met bali. zo asura mippene balah shel zo vezo asura mippene balah shel zo. sheen yevimtah neemenet lehaid lah shemmet yevamah kemo shebbearnu:

Haya leachat mehen ed shemmet balah. zo sheyyesh lah haed omedet beissurah sheenah asura mippene balah ella mippene yevamah. vezo sheen lah ed mutteret shehare heid haed shemmet yevamah vehi neemenet lomar shemmet bali:
Haya lazo banim velazo en banim zo sheen lah banim asura vezo sheyyesh lah banim mutteret. haya lahen yavam acher kan hare ze meyabbem lishtehen:
Met ze hayyavam sheyyibbem otan asurot lehinnase lezar keshehayu battechilla. nityabbemu venitgarshu hare ellu muttarot lezar:

Af al pi shehaishsha neemenet lomar met bali vetinnase o tityabbem en hayevama neemenet lomar met yevami shettinnase lezar hoil vehu issur lav shemma yihye kal beeneha. vechen en hayyavam neeman lomar met achi sheyyeyabbem et ishto shemma enav natan bah. veen haishsha neemenet lomar meta achoti shettikkanes levetah. veen haish neeman lomar meta ishti sheyyissa et achotah ad sheyyaidu shene edim shemmeta achotah veachar kach tikkanes levetah. shello heeminu ed echad ella mishshum hattarat aguna kemo shebbearnu:

Lefichach haishsha shehalcha hi uvalah vivamah limdinat hayyam uvaa veamra met bali veachar kach met yevami. o sheamra met yevami veachar kach met bali hare zo enah neemenet. aval im halcha hi uvalah bilvad uvaa veamra nittan li yavam bimdinat hayyam vamet. ben sheamra met yevami veachar kach met bali ben sheamra met bali veachar kach met hayyavam shennittan li hare zo neemenet shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir:

Haishsha shehalcha hi uvalah uvenah limdinat hayyam uvaa veamra met bali veachar kach met beni neemenet. shehare hayta bechezkat hetter lezar beet shehalcha. amra met beni veachar kach met bali enah neemenet lehityabbem vechoshshin lidvareha vecholetzet velo mityabbemet:

Halcha hi uvalah bilvad uvaa veamra nittan li ben bimdinat hayyam vamet veachar kach met bali neemenet umityabbemet shehare hayta bechezkat hetter livamah beet shehalcha. amra met bali veachar kach met habben shennittan li enah neemenet liftor atzmah min hayyibbum umin hachalitza vechoshshin lidvareha vecholetzet velo mityabbemet:

Bamme devarim amurim beshehayta pesula lichhunna mittechilla kegon shehayta gerusha o chalala o sheamra bammeara hayinu keshemmet. aval im en haddavar ken enah choletzet. shemma tachalotz veyavou edim veyaidu shehaddavar kemo sheamra vehabbaal met techilla venimtzet chalitza zo enah kelum vetinnase lechohen veyire haroe otah shechaltza venisset lechohen vidamme shehachalutza mutteret lichhunna vehu eno yodea baedim shebbau. lefichach lo tachalotz velo tityabbem ella tishshaer bechezkat zekuka kesheyyatza ad sheyyavou edim:

Vechen ishsha shehalach balah vetzaratah limdinat hayyam uvau shenayim veamru lah met balech hare zo lo tachalotz velo tityabbem leolam ad sheyyivvada im yalda tzaratah o lo yalda. velamma lo tachalotz achar tisha chodashim mimmitat habbaal vetihye mutteret lezar al kol panim sheim yalda tzaratah hare niftera zo veim lo yalda hare nechletza. gezera shemma yivvada achar hachalitza sheyyalda tzaratah valad shel kayyama venimtzet zot sheenah chalutza vetinnase lechohen achar shennechletza veyomar haroe shello yada baedim shebbau shehachalutza mutteret lechohen veyaid sheraa otah nisset lichhunna al pi bet din. lefichach im hayta asura lichhunna mittechillatah hare zo choletzet leachar tisha vetinnase lezar. aval zo hatztzara shehayta im balah keshemmet tamtin tishim yom kishar hayevamot vetachlotz o tityabbem velo tachush letzaratah shebbammedina haacheret hoil velo haya balah immah bammedina:

Haishsha shemmet balah vehayta lah chamot bimdinat hayyam enah chosheshet shemma yalda chamotah uchevar nittan lah yavam bimdina acheret. shello gazru bedavar ze. ella naamid otah al chezkatah vahare hi mutteret. vehu haddin leishsha shemmet balah vehaya lo ben bimdina acheret hare zo mutteret lezar veen choshshin shemma met habben ella haamed otah al chezkatah:
Yatzat chamotah meubberet hare zo chosheshet velo tinnase lezar ad shetteda me haya sof ibbur chamotah shemma nolad lah yavam kodem mitat habbaal:

Haishsha shehalach balah uvenah limdinat hayyam uvau veamru lah met balech veachar kach met benech venisset veachar kach noda shechilluf hayu haddevarim tetze vehavvalad kasher. amru lah met benech veachar kach met balech venityabbema veachar kach noda shehayu haddevarim chilluf tetze vehavvalad shennolad lifne hashshemua o leachar hashshemua mamzer:

Ketzad mitzvat chalitza. hayevama holechet achar hayyavam bemakom shehu sham uvaa laddayyanin. vehen korin lo venotnin lo etza hahogenet lo velah. im etza tova leyabbem yoatzin oto leyabbem. veim etza tova lachalotz kegon shehayta hi yalda vehu zaken o hi zekena vehu yeled yoatzin oto lachalotz:

Utzerichin haddayyanin likboa makom sheyyeshvu bo veachar kach tachalotz sham bifnehem shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 7)</small> "vealta yevimto hashshara el hazzekenim" vegomer. lo noadu velo kavu makom ella nikru nikra venikret hi vehu lifnehen vechaltzu chalitzatah keshera:

Umelammedin otah veet hayyavam likrot ad shehu vehi yihyu regilin vetihye yechola likrot <small>(Devarim 25 7)</small> "lo ava" binshima achat veachar kach tomar yabbemi. kede shello yihye mashma devareha ava yabbemi:
Umeachar shettihye regila likrot af al pi shello kara binshima achat en makpidin al ze. aval im enah yechola margilin otah ad shetteda:

Vehachalitza bayyom velo ballayla. uvifne shelosha sheyyodin lehakerot. veim echad min hashshelosha ger pasul. vaafillu haya aviv ger veimmo yisreelit lo tachalotz ad sheyyihye aviv veimmo miyyisrael. umitzvatah bachamishsha kede lefarsem haddavar. veotan hashshenayim afillu hayu amme haaretz:

Ketzad choltzin. meviin lo minal shel or sheyyesh lo akev veeno tafur befishtan velovsho beyamin vekosher retzuotav al raglo. veomed hu vehi bifne bet din umakrin layvama bilshon hakkodesh <small>(Devarim 25 7)</small> "meen yevami" vegomer. veachar kach makrin layyavam <small>(Devarim 25 8)</small> "lo chafatzti lekachtah". venoetz raglo baaretz vehi yoshevet ufoshetet yadah bifne bet din umatteret retzuot hamminal meal raglo vecholetzet hamminal umashlechet oto laaretz umishsheyyishshamet rov heakev huttera hayevama lezar:

Veachar kach omedet veyoreket baaretz keneged panav rok hannire laddayyanin. shemmitzvat chalitza sheyyihyu shenehen omdin bishat keria uvishat rekika utzerichin haddayyanin lirot harok hayyotze mippiha. veachar kach makrin lah <small>(Devarim 25 9)</small> "kacha yease laish asher lo yivne et bet achiv" <small>(Devarim 25 10)</small> "venikra shemo beyisrael bet chalutz hannaal":

Hakkol bilshon hakkodesh shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 9)</small> "kacha" ballashon hazze. vechol hayyoshvin sham onim achareha <small>(Devarim 25 10)</small> "chalutz hannaal" shalosh peamim. vetzarich shettitkavven hayevama shettachalotz lo veyitkavven hu sheyyachalotz lah. veyaasu maasim ellu lishman. vehassuma eno choletz shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 9)</small> "veyarka befanav" veen ze roe harok:

Nimtza seder hachalitza kach hu. kora hi techilla <small>(Devarim 25 7)</small> "meen yevami lehakim leachiv shem beyisrael lo ava yabbemi". veachar kach hu omer <small>(Devarim 25 8)</small> "lo chafatzti lekachtah". veachar kach tachalotz. veachar kach tarok. veachar kach tikra <small>(Devarim 25 9)</small> "kacha yease laish asher lo yivne et bet achiv" <small>(Devarim 25 10)</small> "venikra shemo beyisrael bet chalutz hannaal":
Veen hasseder meakkev ella im lo kara battechilla lo hi velo hu o sherakka veachar kach chaltza o shekkara veachar kach rakka chalitzatah keshera:
Velamma lo tachazor vetarok al hasseder shemma yomru rekika levaddah enah kelum veenah poselet min haachin:
Chaltza bilvad velo kara velo rakka chalitzatah keshera. veen tzarich lomar shechaltza vekara velo rakka o shechaltza verakka velo kara shechalitzatah keshera:

Bamme devarim amurim keshehayu yecholin ledabber shehare hen reuyin likrot. aval illemet o illem enan choltzin veim chaltzu chalitzatan pesula. veenan kecheresh vechereshet shechaltzu shello asu kelum. lefi shehacheresh o hachereshet enan bene daat:

Rakka bilvad shello chaltza velo kara. o sherakka vekara velo chaltza hare zo kachalitza pesula. kara hi vehu velo chaltza velo rakka lo asa kelum shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 9)</small> "kacha yease laish". shehammaase shehu hachalitza veharkika hu shemmoil aval hakkeria enah meakkevet veenah moelet:

Chaltza verakka vekara vehem yoshvin o muttin al tziddehen. o shehaya seroch hannaal kashur al shoko min haarkubba ulematta. o shechaltza bifne shelosha amme haaretz sheenan yodin lehakerot. vechen hassuma shechalatz. chalitzato keshera:

Chaltza ballayla o shechaltza bifne shenayim o bifne shelosha venimtza echad mehen karov o pasul. o shehaya hamminal kashur lemala min haarkubba. o shehittir hu veshamta hi o shehittira hi veshamat hu. o shennitkavvena hi velo nitkavven hu. o shennitkavven hu velo nitkavvena hi. vechen ketanna shechaltza legadol. chalitzatan pesula. vechen im chaltza bifne yachid vaafillu beno levenah uvallayla hare zo chalitza pesula. aval cheresh shote vekatan shechaltzu vechol hacholetz lemi shehi petura min hachalitza umin hayyibbum enah chalitza:

Yavam sheraglo hayemanit chatucha eno choletz bismol veim chaltza meal semolo chalitzatah pesula. hayta raglo akumma leachor o hafucha al tziddah o shehaya mehallech al rashe etzbeot raglav hare ze eno choletz shehacholetz tzarich linotz akevo baaretz veze eno yachol. veim chaltza lemi sheraglo kach hare chalitzatah pesula:

Vivama sheyyadeha chatuchot choletzet lechattechilla vaafillu beshinneha shello neemar vechaltza beyadah. chaltza beminal shel beged enah chalitza. aval im chaltza beminal sheen lo akev. o shehaya tafur befishtan. o shehaya minal shel sear o shel siv o shel shaam o shel etz. o shehaya minal gadol sheeno yachol lehallech bo o katan sheeno chofe et rov raglo. o minal parum sheeno chofe rov haregel o nifchat sheen mekabbel rov haregel. chalitzatah pesula:

Chaltza besandal shel etz umechuppe or o hayta karkaito or ulechayav shel sear. o shechaltza sandal shel semol meal raglo hayemanit. o shello haya hamminal shello o (shello) haya gadol sheyyachol lehallech bo. o katan shechofe et rov raglo o nifram shechofe et rov haregel o nifchat shemmekabbel rov haregel. chalitzato keshera:

Sandal hammusgar vehammuchlat veshel akku"40 shemmannichin oto beragle hatztzura lo tachalotz bo. veim chaltza chalitzatah keshera. veaf al pi shehu asur bahanaa. aval sandal shel tikrovet akku"40 veshel ir hanniddachat. o shennaasa lemet sheyyikaver bo. im chaltza bo chalitzatah pesula shehare eno omed lehallech bo:
Kara hamminal meal raglo o shesserafattu o shehaya lavush shete minalin vechaltza haelyon af al pi shekkara hattachton ad shennitgalleta raglo hare zo chalitza pesula:
Yevama sheachla shum o gargir vechayyotze bahen middevarim shemmarbin et harok vehaya harok zav mippiha eno kelum ad sheyyihye harok meatzmo:

Rakka dam o shehaya shotet mippiha eno kelum. veim matztza verakka kasher shei efshar ledam shennimtzatz belo tzichtzuche rok. rakka ukelatattu haruach kodem sheyyaggia lichneged panav kegon shehayta arukka vehu katzar eno kelum. veim achar shehiggia leneged panav af al pi shello higgia laaretz kasher. vechen im lo rau haddayyanin harok kesheyyatza mippiha kasher:

Chalitza mutet pesula. ketzad. kegon sheamru lo chalotz lah uvechach atta konsah. o sheamru lo chalotz lah shezzo mitzva hi veenah mafsedet alecha kelum veim tirtze achar kach leyabbem teyabbem vechayyotze bidvarim ellu pesula. aval im hituhu veamru lo chalotz lah al menat shettitten lecha matayim zuz o al tenay kach vechach af al pi shello natna velo nitkayyem hattenay chalitzatah keshera shehare nitkavven lachalotz lah:

Hammoser modaa al hachalitza chalitzato pesula. lefichach rauy laddayyanin lomar lo levattel hammodaa kederech sheosin beget. lechatzuhu yisreelim vehikkuhu ad shechalatz im kaddin asu chalitzato keshera. veim shello kaddin asu kegon shehayu hedyotot o shettau chalitzato pesula. veim haakku"40 anasuhu meatzman. im haya haddin noten sheyyachalotz chalitzato pesula. veim shello kaddin enah chalitza:

Kol makom sheamarnu enah chalitza o lo asa kelum o enah kelum hare hi keillu lo nechletza lo velo neesru alav kerovoteha velo nifsela min hakkehunna umutteret lehityabbem. vechol makom sheamarnu chalitzatah pesula neesru alav kerovoteha venifsela min hakkehunna veneesra al haachin veenah mityabbemet veenah mutteret lehinnase lezar ad shettachalotz chalitza keshera:
Avra venisset hare ze choletz lah chalitza keshera vehi tachat balah veen motziin otah miyyado:

Yevama sheggadla ben haachin hare zo mutteret lehityabbem veen choshshin lah shemma chaltza leechad mehen beno levenah venifsela alehen. aval im reinuha shechaltza naalo shel echad mehen nifsela shemma nitkavvena lachalitza utzericha chalitza keshera lehattirah lezar:

Get chalitza sheanu kotvin lah eno ella maase bet din kede sheyyihye beyadah reaya shennechletza veen haddayyanin choltzin ella im ken makkirin. lefichach mi sheraa zot shennechletza kotvin lah get chalitza af al pi sheenan makkirin shezzo hi bat peloni veeshet peloni veshezze shechalatz lah achiv hu. shehare haddayyanin shechaltza bifnehem hikkiru ze veachar kach chaltza:

Vezehu nusach get chalitza shennahagu bo haam: beyom peloni kach vechach leyerach peloni shenat kach vechach livriat alma leminyana deragilna lemimne bah bemakom peloni anachna dayyane demiktzatna chatimin letatta bemotav telata kachada havena yatvin beve dina uselika lokodamana pelonit barat peloni armelata difloni. vekarvat lokodamana gevar chad dishmeh peloni bar peloni. vechen amra lana pelonit da. peloni bar peloni dena achuha difloni bali meavuha hava dahavena nesiva leh veshachiv vechayye lerabbanan ulechol yisrael shavak. uvar uvarat yarit umachsin umokim shema beyisrael lo shavak. vehaden peloni achohi chazi leyibbumi yati. kean rabbanan amru leh i tzavi leyibbumi yati yeyabbem vei lo yitla li ragleh dimina kodomechon veashre seneh meal ragleh veerok beanpohi. veishtemodanuhu lifloni dena daachohi difloni mitna meavuhi hu vaamarna leh i tzavit leyibbume yatah yabbem vei lo atla lah kodomana raglach dimina vetishre senach meal raglach vetarok beanpach. veani veamar lana let ana tzavi leyibbume yatah. miyyad akrinuha liflonit da meen yevami lehakim leachiv shem beyisrael lo ava yabbemi. veaf lehay peloni akrinuhu leh lo chafatzti lekachtah. veatla lah ragleh dimina vesharat seneh meal ragleh verakat beanpohi roka deitchazi lana mippumah al ara. vetuv akrinuha liflonit da kacha yease laish asher lo yivne et bet achiv venikra shemo beyisrael bet chalutz hannaal. vaanachna dayyane vechol dehauu yatvin kodomana anenan batreh chalutz hannaal chalutz hannaal chalutz hannaal telat zimnin. umiddeitavid uvda da kodomana sharinuha liflonit da limhach lehitnasba lechol man detitzbe veinash lo yimche beyodah min yoma denan ulealam. uvait minnana pelonit da gitta dachalitzuta da uchetavna vachatamna vihavna lah lizchu kedat moshe veyisrael. peloni bar peloni ed. peloni bar peloni ed:

Umeidin alav shelosha o shenayim min hashshelosha o shenayim sherau hachalitza af al pi sheenan haddayyanin shechaltza bifnehen kemo shebbearnu. vaafillu ishsha o eved o katan shehu makkir venavon neemanin lomar ze peloni achi peloni vezo hi yevimto vecholtzin al pihen. ma sheen ken bishar eduyyot shel tora ben leedut mamon ben leedut issur. shezze davar heasuy lehiggalot hu efshar leda amittat haddavar shello mippihen kainyan shebbearnu besof hilchot gerushin. veim ratza hayyavam leyabbem mekaddesh umeyabbem vechotev lah ketubba kemo shehodanu:

Vezehu nusach ketubbat yevamin shennahagu haam: beyom peloni kach vechach leyerach peloni shenat kach vechach leminyan peloni leminyana deragilna lemimne bemakom peloni ech peloni ben peloni ata lokodamana vechen amar lana. achi demin abba shachiv vechayye lerabbanan ulechol yisrael shavak. uvar uvarat yarit umachsin umokim shema beyisrael lo shavak. veshavak hahi itteta dishmah pelonit bat peloni vechazi li min orayta leyibbume yatah kedichtiv besefer orayta demoshe yevamah yavo aleha. utzeviat pelonit da veityabbemat lifloni bar peloni yevamah leokume shema beyisrael kedichtiv vehaya habbechor asher teled yakum al shem achiv hammet vegomer. vechatav lah peloni yevamah liflonit yevimteh kesef zuze matan dechazu lah dahavu ketivin bichtubbatah dechatav lah balah kadmaa veosif lah middileh kach vechach veda neduneya dehanalat leh vechulei kishar tafse ketubbot:

Tavepas hakketuva: beyom peloni kulei. ech peloni ben peloni amar liflonit bat peloni betulta kallata hevi li leintu kedat moshe veyisrael vaana bememar dishmayya eflach veokir vaasovar veezun vaafarnes veichse yatichi kehilchot guvrin yehudain demokrin umesovrin vezanin umefarnesin umechassin yat neshehon bekushta. veyahivna lechi mohar betullechi kesef zuze matan deinun mizzuze kaspa 20"5 dechazu lechi middeorayta umezonaychi uchesutaychi vesippukaychi. umeal alaychi keorach kol ara. utzeviat pelonit da vahavat leh leintu lifloni dena. veratza vehosif lah tosefet al ikkar ketubbatah ad mishlam kach vechach veda neduneya dehanalat leh kach vechach hakkol nitkabbel chatan ze uva leyado venaase birshuto vezakaf hakkol al atzmo kemilve ureshu. vechen amar lana peloni chatana dena acharayut ketuvta kola ikkar ketubba uneduneya vetosefet ushear tenae ketubba kabbalit alay veal yartay batrai veal kol shefar arag nichsin vekinyanin deit li techot [kol] shemayya dekannai udeatid ana lemikna mimmekarkee umimmittaltele aggav mekarkee kullehon yehon achrain vearvain lichtubba da kola ikkar uneduneya vetosefet leitpara minnehon bechayyay uvatar moti vaafillu miggelima deal katfai. vekaninan mippeloni da mikkol may dichtiv umefarash leela kinyan shalem delo keasmachta udela ketofsa dishtare ella kechozek uchechomer kol shitre ketubbot hannohagot beyisrael vechahogen uchetikkun rabbotenu za"30 vechatamnu al shetar ketubba zo bazzeman hannizkar leel vehakkol barir vesharir vekayyam:

Veim hayta ketubbat almana kotev pelonit almenata. veim hayta ketubbat gerusha kotev pelonit haggerusha. vechen im hayta shevuya kotev pelonit hashshevuya kede shello yikkashel bah kohen. vechotev veyahivna lechi moharaychi kesef zuze mea deinun mizzuze kaspa teresar ufalga dechazu lechi vechulei:

Keshekkotvin get yevamin o ketubbat yevamin mesartet mekom happesukim. sheasur lichtov shalosh tevot belo sirtut. vivama shechaltza mutteret lehinnase beyom chalitzatah shehare enah choletzet ad shettashlim tishim yom:

Hayevama shennatan lah hayyavam get keritut pesalah ufasal et tzaroteha alav veal shear haachin shehare naasa kemi shechalatz lah. veen hagget moil bivama ella middivrehen hoil vehagget megaresh eshet ish. vechol get shepposel ishto min hakkehunna posel et yevimto min hayyibbum veenah mutteret lezar ad sheyyachalotz lah:
Hammaamar af al pi sheeno kone bivama kinyan gamur veenah naaset bo eshet ish gemura tzericha mimmennu get veenah nitteret lezar ella bachalitza:

Ketzad. haose maamar bivimto veeno rotze livol tzarich lichtov lah get shehare nitkaddesha lo. vetzarich lachalotz lah kede lehattirah lezar. sheen hayevama nitteret lezar ella achar beilat hayyavam o achar chalitza. aval hagget poslah leyibbum veeno mattirah lezar. vehammaamar eno kone bah kinyan gamur kemo habbeila:
Natan maamar livimto vechazar venatan get lemaamaro ma sheasa hare bittelo vehuttera. veyerae li shello huttera ella leechav aval ze shennatan hagget asura hi lo:
Natan get lezikkato [velo lemaamaro] pesalah alav veal shear haachin kemo shebbearnu utzericha get lemaamaro vachalitza lehattirah lezar:

Hammaamar shennittan livama techilla velo kedamo davar acher velo naasa acharav davar acher ella shebbaal otah ze shennatan lah hammaamar hu hannikra maamar kasher. veim kedamo get o chalitza ben miyyavam ze ben miyyavam acher ben bah ben betzaratah. vechen im kedamattu beila betzaratah ben mimmennu ben meechav. o shennaasa acharav get o chalitza ben bah ben betzaratah ben mimmennu ben meechav. o shebbaal o natan maamar acher letzaratah ben hu ben achiv. o shennatan lah achiv maamar acher o bealah hare ze nikra maamar pasul. ben hammaamar shekkedamuhu hammaasim haellu ben hammaamar shennitacharu acharav:

Ketzad. natan get o chalatz livimto vechazar venatan maamar lah o letzaratah ben hu ben echav. o shebba al yevimto o natan lah maamar vechazar venatan lah maamar acher letzaratah ben hu ben echav. o shennatan maamar livimto vechazar achiv venatan lah maamar acher o bealah hare ze maamar pasul ben hammaamar harishon ben hammaamar haacharon:

Nimtzeta lamed shehammaamar ben shekkedamo maamar acher o get o chalitza o beila. ben shekkadam hammaamar leechad meellu. hare ze maamar pasul. chutz min hannoten maamar uvaal beila achar hammaamar shezzo hi kehilchatah:

Habbeila shebboel hayyavam et yevimto techilla o achar maamaro bah velo kedamah davar acher nikret beila keshera. veim kedamah maamar meechav o get ben mimmennu ben meechav ben bah ben betzaratah. o shekkedamah maamar betzaratah ben mimmennu ben meechav hare zo nikret beila pesula:

Hachalitza shecholetz hayyavam livimto techilla im lo kedamah davar acher nikret chalitza meulla. veim kedamah get o maamar ben miyyavam ze ben meechav ben bah ben betzaratah hare zo nikret chalitza pechuta:

Yevamot rabbot habbaot mibbayit echad kevan shennivala achat mehen beila keshera o nechletza chalitza meulla hutteru hakkol venistalleka zikkat hayyavam mealehen. veim nivala achat mehen beila pesula o nittan lah maamar pasul neesru kullan leyibbum utzericha get zo shennivala o shennittan lah maamar. utzericha chalitza [kol] achat mehen lehattiran lezar. sheen zikkat hayyibbum mistalleket bivila pechuta:

Nechletza achat mehen chalitza pechuta huttera lehinnase lezar zo shennechletza aval tzaratah asura ad shettachalotz gam hi o ad sheyyachletzu kol haachin larishona shennechletza hachalitza happechuta. sheen chalitza pechuta mesalleket zikkat yibbum mibbayit ze ad shettachazor al kol haachin o ad shettechaletz kol achat mehen:

Kol yevama shennivala livamah ben beila keshera ben beila pesula. vaafillu bealah achar shechalatz lah ben hu ben echav ben leshem ishut ben leshem yabbemut. vaafillu baal tzaratah achar shebbaal beila keshera ben hu ben echav. hare zo tzericha get shehare naaset eshet ish babbeila. vechen kol yevama shennittan lah maamar ben maamar kasher ben maamar pasul hare zo tzericha get mippene hammaamar kemo shebbearnu veachar kach yasur issur hammaamar:

Kevar amarnu sheen hagget doche hayevama dechiyya gemura vechen hammaamar eno kone bah kinyan gamur. aval habbeila kona kinyan gamur. vehachalitza docha otah dechiyya gemura. lefichach get achar get bivama o maamar achar maamar moil. aval beila achar beila vachalitza achar chalitza en haacharona moelet kelum. vechen get o chalitza achar habbeila enah kelum:

Ketzad. yavam shennatan get livimto vechazar venatan get letzaratah hare ze asur bikrovot shetehen. vechen shene yevamin shennatnu shene gittin livama achat ze achar ze hare zo kigrusha lishnehen ushenehen asurin bikrovoteha veechad mehen choletz. vechen im natan get livimto vechazar venatan achiv get letzaratah kol echad asur bikrovot zo shennatan lah hagget. vechen im natnu maamar achar maamar kemo shebbearnu. aval hayyavam shechalatz livimto vechazar vechalatz letzaratah ben hu ben achiv. vechen shete yevamin shechaltzu ze achar ze livama achat en chalitza acharona kelum veen hacholetz otah baacharona asur bikrovoteha. shezze kecholetz lishar hannashim sheen lo alehen zikka:

Vechen habboel yevimto vechazar ben hu ben achiv vechalatz lah o letzaratah en chalitza zo kelum. vechen im chazar achiv venatan get lah o letzaratah eno kelum. chazar achiv venatan lah maamar o baal lo asa kelum meachar shebbaal achiv techilla kana kinyan gamur veen hakkiddushin tofsin beeshet ish. aval im natan maamar letzaratah o baal tzaratah tzericha get mimmennu kemo shebbearnu:

Shene yevamin sheyyibbemu shete yevamot habbaot mibbayit echad velo noda mi yibbem techilla shenehen yotziu beget veyutteru lezarim vaasurot layvamin. lefichach reuven shehaya birushalayim velo shete nashim achat beakko veachat betzor veshimon achiv beakko velevi achiv betzor veshamu shemmet reuven haddin noten shello yeyabbem echad mehen ad sheyyivvada me asa achiv shemma kadam veyibbem. kadam echad mehen veyibbem en motziin miyyado ad sheyyivvada sheachiv yibbem techilla. ratza haechad lachalotz kodem sheyyada me asa achiv en monin oto:

Yavam katan ben tesha shanim veyom echad biato kemaamar min haggadol sheeno kone kinyan gamur. umaamar ben tesha shanim veyom echad im netano battechilla moil vahare hu posel bo al haggadol aval im netano bassof eno kelum. vegitto vachalitzato enam kelum ben battechilla ben bassof:

Ketzad. ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto o shennatan lah maamar techilla pesalah al shear achin. aval im asa haggadol maamar bivimto vechazar ben tesha shanim veyom echad venatan lah o letzaratah maamar lo asa kelum velo pesalah al achiv haggadol. chazar ben tesha shanim veyom echad uva aleha o al tzaratah achar maamar achiv haggadol pesalah al haggadol kishne gedolim sheasu maamar achar maamar kemo shebbearnu:

Ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto vechazar achiv haggadol uva aleha o chalatz o natan get lah o letzaratah hare ze pesalah al hakkatan. vechen im chazar hakkatan uva al tzaratah o ba achiv haacher shehu ben tesha shanim veyom echad aleha o al tzaratah nifsela alav kedin kol maamar umaamar:

Ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto vehigdil velo ba aleha mishshehigdil tzericha get vachalitza. get mippene biato shehi kemaamar vachalitza lehattirah lezar shehare lo nivala beila shekkona kinyan gamur. veim ba aleha mishshehigdil hare zo tzericha get bilvad:
Echad ben tesha shanim veyom echad. veechad ben esrim shana shello hevi shete searot velo noldu bo simane saris kemo shebbearnu bitchillat hassefer:

Ketanna sheruya lemaen. vehachereshet. af al pi shekkiddushe shetehen middivre sofrim kemo shebbearnu shene mine kiddushin hen. ketanna yesh lah kiddushin kede shello yinhagu bah minhag hefker. vekiddusheha teluyin ad shettagdil. vechereshet tikkenu lah nissuin kede shello tishshaer penuya leolam. lefichach im hayu kol hayevamot habbaot mibbayit echad ketannot o chershot biatah shel achat mehen poteret et kullan:

Hayta achat chereshet veachat ketanna en biat achat mehen poteret et tzaratah. vechetzad takkanatan. melammedin hakketanna shettemaen vechones et hachereshet. veim ratza legarshah kotev lah get achar sheyyavo aleha vetuttar lezar:

Hayta achat pikkachat veachat chereshet biat happikkachat o chalitzatah poteret hachereshet. veen biat hachereshet poteret happikkachat sheen kiddusheha ella middivrehen. vechen gedola uketanna biat haggedola o chalitzatah poteret hakketanna veen biat hakketanna poteret et haggedola:

Hayu shetehen ketannot haruyot lemaen uva hayyavam al achat mehen vechazar uva o hu o achiv al hashsheniyya lo pasal et harishona. aval melammedin et hashsheniyya shettemaen vikayyem ze yevimto hakketanna shennivala techilla:

Vechen haddin biktanna vechereshet shebba hayyavam techilla al hakketanna vechazar uva hu o achiv al hachereshet lo pasal et hakketanna vehachereshet tzericha get. shebbiat hakketanna meulla mibbiat hachereshet. shehakketanna reuya leachar zeman. lefichach yekayyem hakketanna shennivala techilla:
Ba hayyavam techilla al hachereshet vechazar uva hu o achiv al hakketanna pasal et hachereshet. umelammedin hakketanna shettemaen vehachereshet yotza beget:

Hayu achat pikkachat veachat chereshet. ba hayyavam al happikkachat vechazar uva hu o achiv al hachereshet lo pasal et happikkachat vehachereshet tzericha get. ba hayyavam al hachereshet vechazar hu o achiv uva al happikkachat pasal et hachereshet. vehachereshet yotza beget. vehappikkachat beget uvachalitza:

Hayu gedola uketanna uva al haggedola vechazar hu o achiv uva al hakketanna lo pasal haggedola umelammedin et hakketanna shettemaen. ba al hakketanna vechazar uva hu o achiv al haggedola. melammedin et hakketanna shettemaen vikayyem haggedola shebbeilatah kona kinyan gamur:

Yesh achin sheruyin leyibbum o lachalitza. veyesh achin sheenan reuyin lo leyibbum velo lachalitza veen lahen zikka kelal ella yevimto mutteret lezar. veyesh achin sheruyin lachalitza veenan reuyin leyibbum. veyesh achin shehen reuyin leyibbum veenan reuyin lachalitza:
Veellu hem sheen lahen zikka kelal. seris chamma veanderoginus mippene sheenan reuyin leled velo haya lahen sheat hakkosher:

Veellu meyabbemin velo choltzin. hacheresh vehashshote vehakkatan mippene sheen bahen daat lachalotz. uchesheyyibbem hacheresh eno motzi leolam shebbeilato osa otah eshet ish gemura veen gerushav gerushin gemurin. uven tesha shanim veyom echad sheyyibbem eno yachol legaresh ad sheyyagdil kemo shebbearnu:

Veellu choltzin velo meyabbemin. hassefekot kegon shehayta sefek erva al achiv. ufetzua dakka ucherut shafcha vechayyotze bahen mimmine hasserus. vehazzaken beyoter shettashash kocho vechashal. veim baal seris adam kana shehare hayta lo sheat hakkosher umotzi beget mippene shehu asur lavo bakkahal. vehattumtum choletz velo meyabbem mippene shehu safek. veim nikra venimtza zachar ratza choletz ratza meyabbem. ushear haachin o choltzin o meyabbemin:

Yesh yevamot shehen reuyot lachalitza o leyibbum. veyesh yevamot sheenan reuyot lo lachalitza velo leyibbum veen alehen zikka kelal umuttarot lehinnase lezar. veyesh yevamot shehen reuyot lachalitza aval lo leyibbum. veyesh yevamot shehen reuyot leyibbum aval lo lachalitza:
Veellu shemmityabbemot velo choltzot. hachereshet vehashshota vehakketanna lefi sheen bahen daat likrot ulehavin. veim ratza hayyavam legaresh hachereshet beget achar sheyyivol otah hare ze megaresh:

Veellu shecholtzot velo mityabbemot. issure lavin vehashsheniyyot veissure ase kemo sheyyitbaer. vechol ishsha shehi sefek megoreshet choletzet velo mityabbemet shemma yifga beerva. sheeshet achiv sheggershah asura alav mishshum erva. aval mi shehi mekuddeshet leachiv bisfek kiddushin hare hi kishar kol hayevamot vecholetzet o mityabbemet sheen kan davar lachush lo. vechen eshet hacheresh uzekena vaakara hare hen kishar kol hayevamot. ratza choletz ratza meyabbem. shezzekena vaakara hayta lahen sheat hakkosher:

Veellu hen shehen peturot min hachalitza umin hayyibbum. eshet seris chamma veanderoginus veeshet hashshote veeshet hakkatan veaylonit umi shehi erva. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 6)</small> "velo yimmache shemo miyyisrael" perat lisris chamma veanderoginus sheshshemam machuy hoil veenan reuyin leled mittechillat beriyyatan hare hen kemin bifne atzmo. <small>(Devarim 25 6)</small> "vehaya habbechor asher teled" perat leaylonit sheenah reuya leled mittechillat beriyyatah. <small>(Devarim 25 5)</small> "lo tihye eshet hammet" perat leeshet shote vekatan mippene sheen lahem ishut kelal. <small>(Devarim 25 5)</small> "ulekachah lo leishsha" perat leerva sheen lo bah likkuchin:

Ketzad. yevama shehi erva al yevamah kegon shehayta achot ishto o immah o bittah hare zo petura min hachalitza umin hayyibbum veen lo aleha zikka kelal shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 5)</small> "ulekachah lo leishsha veyibbemah". mi sheruya lelikkuchin vekiddushin tofsin bah hi zekuka leyavam:

Hayta hayevama asura al yevamah issur lav o issur ase o shehayta sheniyya hare zo choletzet velo mityabbemet. umippene ma tzericha chalitza mippene sheyyesh bah likkuchin hoil vekiddushin tofsin bahen hare hen zekukot leyavam. umin haddin haya sheyyityabbemu shehayyibbum mitzvat ase vechol makom sheatta motze ase velo taase yavo ase veyidche et lo taase. aval chachamim gazru shello yityabbemu chayyave lavin velo sheniyyot gezera shemma yavo aleha paam sheniyya vahare biatah asura veen sham mitzva sheen mitzvat ase ella bia rishona bilvad. lefichach im avar uvaal yevimto haasura lo mishshum lav o mishshum ase veen tzarich lomar sheniyya hare ze kana kinyan gamur umotziah beget vehi vechol tzaroteha muttarot lezar shehare nifteru:
Vivama shehi almana min hannissuin uva aleha kohen gadol lo niftera tzaratah sheen ase doche et lo taase vaase. vehoil velo kana min hattora kinyan gamur lo huttera tzaratah lezar ad shettachalotz:

Hayta hayevama erva al balah. kegon sheavar o taa velakach achoto meaviv venafla lifne achiv. en zo ishto sheen kiddushin tofsin bah veenah lo bat yibbum velo bat chalitza. veim hayta lah tzara choletzet [o] mityabbemet. veim hayta zo shehi erva al habbaal mutteret layyavam veratza hayyavam lissa otah uleyabbem tzaratah harshut beyado:
